meaning.zh:
“漆黑一片” 或 “伸手不见五指”。

这个短语源于 “pitch”，一种非常黑的物质。将它用作形容词来表示完全没有光线，非常黑暗的状态。
meaning.en: The phrase originates from "pitch," a substance known for its extreme blackness. It is used as an adjective to describe a condition where there is no light at all, an extremely dark state.

lines.en: It was *pitch dark* outside, so we could barely see anything.
lines.zh: 外面漆黑一片，我们几乎什么都看不见。

lines.en: After the power went out, the whole house was *pitch dark*.
lines.zh: 停电之后，整座房子立刻伸手不见五指。

lines.en: They had to use flashlights because the cave was *pitch dark*.
lines.zh: 他们不得不用手电筒，因为洞穴里漆黑一片。
